add_contact_to_list.description: Subscribe an existing contact to an ActiveCampaign list.
add_contact_to_list.name: add_contact_to_list

parameters.description: The ID of the contact to subscribe.
parameters.name: contact_id

parameters.description: The ID of the list to subscribe the contact to.
parameters.name: list_id

parameters.description: Whether to subscribe or unsubscribe the contact. Defaults to Subscribed.
parameters.name: status

add_tags_to_contact.description: Add one or more tags to a contact by name. A tag that doesn't exist yet is created.
add_tags_to_contact.name: add_tags_to_contact

parameters.description: The contact's ID: contact_id from Create or update contact, or contact.id from Find contact or Create contact.
parameters.name: contact_id

parameters.description: The tag names to add, such as VIP. Commas aren't allowed in a name.
parameters.name: tags

contactTags.description: Each tag now on the contact from this step.

apply_tag_to_contact.description: Assign an existing tag to a contact.
apply_tag_to_contact.name: apply_tag_to_contact

parameters.description: The ID of the contact to tag.
parameters.name: contact_id

parameters.description: The ID of the tag to apply.
parameters.name: tag_id

create_contact.description: Create a new contact in ActiveCampaign with optional profile details.
create_contact.name: create_contact

parameters.description: Contact email
parameters.name: email

parameters.description: First name
parameters.name: first_name

parameters.description: Last name
parameters.name: last_name

parameters.description: Phone number
parameters.name: phone

create_deal.description: Create a new deal linked to a pipeline stage and contact.
create_deal.name: create_deal

parameters.description: Deal title
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: The ID of the contact to link the deal to. Optional.
parameters.name: contact_id

parameters.description: The ID of the pipeline stage to place the deal in.
parameters.name: stage_id

parameters.description: The ID of the account user who will own this deal. Leave blank to use the pipeline's auto-assign owner; required if auto-assign is disabled. User IDs are under Settings > Users in ActiveCampaign.
parameters.name: owner_id

parameters.description: The deal amount in the chosen currency, for example 1500 for $1,500. Decimals are allowed.
parameters.name: value

parameters.description: Three-letter currency code, for example USD. Defaults to USD.
parameters.name: currency

parameters.description: The ID of the pipeline the stage belongs to. Optional; usually determined by the stage.
parameters.name: pipeline_id

create_list.description: Create a marketing list for organizing contacts and campaigns.
create_list.name: create_list

parameters.description: List name
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Your company or website address, for example https://acme.com. ActiveCampaign shows this in the email footer to comply with anti-spam laws.
parameters.name: sender_url

parameters.description: A short note reminding contacts why they are receiving your emails, for example 'You signed up on our website'. A generic reminder is used if left blank.
parameters.name: sender_reminder

parameters.description: A unique short name for the list. One is generated from the list name if left blank.
parameters.name: stringid

create_or_update_contact.description: Add a contact, or update the one who already has this email address, and tag them in the same step if you like. Fields left blank keep what's there.
create_or_update_contact.name: create_or_update_contact

parameters.description: The contact's email address.
parameters.name: email

parameters.description: First name
parameters.name: first_name

parameters.description: Last name
parameters.name: last_name

parameters.description: Phone number
parameters.name: phone

parameters.description: Tag names to put on the contact in this same step, such as ebook, so no separate 'Add tags to contact' step is needed. A tag that doesn't exist yet is created, and tags the contact already has stay. Commas aren't allowed in a name. Leave empty to add no tags.
parameters.name: tags

parameters.description: The name of the contact's company, such as Acme Inc. The contact is linked to the account with that name in ActiveCampaign, which is created if there isn't one. Needs ActiveCampaign's Accounts feature. Leave empty to keep the contact's account as it is.
parameters.name: company

contact.description: The contact as ActiveCampaign returns it: id, email, firstName, lastName, phone and ActiveCampaign's other details. For a new contact it holds only the details this step set. Prefer contact_id and email.

contact_id.description: The contact's ID in ActiveCampaign, a whole number such as 42. Add contact to list, Add tags to contact and Create deal take it.

created.description: True when the contact is new, false when someone already had this email address and was updated.

tags.description: The tag names this step added. Empty when none were given.

create_tag.description: Create a reusable tag to organize contacts and automations.
create_tag.name: create_tag

parameters.description: Tag name. Commas are not allowed.
parameters.name: tag

parameters.description: Tag description
parameters.name: description

find_contact.description: Look up a contact by email address. Says whether they were found, without failing the step when they aren't.
find_contact.name: find_contact

parameters.description: The email address to look for.
parameters.name: email

contact.description: The contact's details (id, email, firstName, lastName, phone), empty when not found.

found.description: Whether a contact has this email.

remove_tag_from_contact.description: Take a tag off a contact by its name. The tag itself is kept. Doesn't fail when the contact doesn't have the tag.
remove_tag_from_contact.name: remove_tag_from_contact

parameters.description: The contact's ID: contact_id from Create or update contact, or contact.id from Find contact or Create contact.
parameters.name: contact_id

parameters.description: The name of the tag to take off.
parameters.name: tag

removed.description: False when the contact didn't have the tag.

update_deal.description: Change a deal: move it to another stage, mark it won or lost, or change its title, amount or owner. Fields left blank keep what's there.
update_deal.name: update_deal

parameters.description: The deal's ID, from Create deal or the deal's address in ActiveCampaign.
parameters.name: deal_id

parameters.description: The ID of the pipeline stage to move the deal to.
parameters.name: stage_id

parameters.description: Mark the deal open, won or lost.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: A new title for the deal.
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: The new deal amount, for example 1500 for $1,500.
parameters.name: value

parameters.description: Three-letter currency code, for example USD.
parameters.name: currency

parameters.description: The ID of the account user who should own the deal (Settings > Users).
parameters.name: owner_id

deal.description: The deal's details after the change.

description: Automate ActiveCampaign: create, find and update contacts, tag them, and create and move deals.

activecampaign_new_contact_trigger.description: Runs for each new contact in your ActiveCampaign account, with their email, name and phone. Contacts already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

activecampaign_tag_added_trigger.description: Runs each time a tag is added to a contact in ActiveCampaign, with the contact's email, name and phone. Tags added before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.tagged_at: When the tag was added to them.

parameters.description: The name of the tag to watch for, as it appears in ActiveCampaign.
parameters.name: tag
